details:
Give meaningful rewards to medium and large world creators.

Everyone knows it: players, creators, and VRChat staff. VRChat exists because of its user base and the content creators. VRChat is a social game that depends on its creator community. Without creators, VRChat would not have avatars or worlds beyond what the VRChat staff team builds themselves.

Right now, the only reliable ways for creators to reward themselves are adding ads and posters to their worlds, or gating features behind VIP rooms using Patreon or VRChat’s monetization systems.

World creators deserve built-in rewards. That could be VRChat Plus for qualifying creators, or other perks. Another idea is a new curated world tab for medium and large creators, curated by selected creators.

There are plenty of ways to reward medium and large world creators. For example, I have spent thousands of hours on world development, UdonSharp development, and more. Some of my worlds have 100,000 visits, and others have 1,000,000 visits. Do I get any benefit from these worlds? No. They might appear in Popular for a short time, then get buried by the same recurring worlds we have seen for years (McDonalds, Among Us, The Black Cat, Just B Club 4, and others).

VRChat needs a serious change in how the Worlds tab works and how creators are rewarded. The platform does not run without creators, and creators should be able to earn recognition and rewards without feeling forced to add ads, posters, or shop systems to their worlds. The Worlds tab also needs improvement. It is the same worlds on repeat. Add a new tab and let selected creators curate it so the community can discover something new. Not everyone wants to visit The Black Cat all the time.

Please consider updating the Worlds tab and introducing better creator rewards.
title: World Creator Rewards And World Tab Update
